text: Flint drags Vale into a real 6pm Sector Gamma pipe-walk on top of their 6:30 data date, then Flint and Dusk both plant flags on Vale's bio-filtration records, turning the 7am filtration basin meetup into a three-way pileup with soil samples now required homework. Dusk and Flint keep bickering over whether Mrs. Elara's smile is proof of anything, while Reed and Lumen stay unbothered, locking in their 8am aphid rescue plus Lumen's after-garden tea invite to Vale. The town's split is hardening: pipes-and-data drama on one side, bugs-and-kindness peace on the other, and Vale is now double-booked in the middle of it.
